A humanitarian mission entered the devastated city of Oleshky on Friday, officials said, as Russia and Ukraine observed the most significant truce of the 4½-year war that began with Moscow’s full-scale invasion of its neighbor, The Associated Press reports.
Christa Pike said she is in constant pain since surviving a lethal injection in Tennessee last month but thankful for the love and support she has received, The Associated Press reports.
A sell-off for tech stocks is forcing the U.S. market down again, with Amazon and Intel helping lead the way this time, The Associated Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
